purpose: Separate market selection, product definition, representative experience, product quality, technical manufacturability, mandatory front matter, external preview evidence, and release readiness.
invariants: PRODUCT_QUALITY is independent from FACTUAL_SOURCE, EDITORIAL and TECHNICAL
TECHNICAL_PASS is diagnostic and cannot imply FINAL, KDP_READY, or publication readiness
Every book requires a passing copyright_page gate before FINAL
Series membership must be explicit; every series book requires a passing series_introduction gate before FINAL
Series recap claims must be sourced from canonical/locked predecessor manuscripts with recorded path and hash
Mandatory front matter is separate from and must not alter the locked narrative manuscript
KDP READY requires every mandatory gate

COMMERCIAL_PACKAGE requires title, subtitle, author, description, exactly seven keyword fields, exactly three category targets, paperback and Kindle prices, primary marketplace, format settings and a cover brief
COMMERCIAL FINALIZATION MUST OCCUR AFTER FINAL CONTENT/LAYOUT FREEZE
A future recheck cannot replace a recommended list price
PAGE COUNT is neither cost nor value
human taste is retained where marginal value is high
backwards_compatibility: Version 1 is retained as historical evidence; new production runs use version 2.
